name: LaunchClash

sources.title: LaunchClash homepage — weekly launch showcase with voting grid and Winners hall of fame
Submit page — login wall ('Log in to Submit')

requirements: Account required: /submit shows 'Log in to Submit' with Google sign-in or account creation
Submissions are reviewed and added to the current or next weekly lineup (manual review)
Weekly competition: fresh batch each week, community votes, winners earn a 'Winners' hall-of-fame spot
preparation: Logo (all entries show a logo tile)
Category tags and pricing label (Free, Freemium, Free Trial, Paid)
A Google account or email for registration
workflow: Create an account at /signup or log in with Google (/api/auth/google?redirect=/submit)
Fill the product submission form (fields behind login)
Product is reviewed and placed into the current or next weekly lineup
Community votes via a pixel-based grid; top-voted products reach the Winners section at week's end
watchFor: Same platform template as Good AI Tools / My Launch Stash (shared footer taxonomy and a third-party 'We Submit Your SaaS to 140+ Directories' ad banner) — the ad is a paid external service, not this site's offer
FAQ says submission is 'completely free' but form fields and dofollow status are not publicly visible
Voting is the whole visibility mechanic — a launch with no votes sits at 0 on the board
countsAsLive: Product appears in the current week's 'Launched This Week' grid on launchclash.com with its logo, categories and a vote count
unknowns: Form fields and badge requirements behind the login wall
Whether paid/featured tiers exist (Featured products section exists but pricing is not public)
Review timeline before entering the weekly lineup
